startup.reason: The pinned stack previously selected the optional FlashInfer sampler and failed its JIT warmup because no compatible nvcc existed. Seeded generation uses vLLM's native sampler path, so every v8 launch inherits the already-reviewed native-sampler setting before the first request.

forbid_log_patterns: Using FlashInfer for top-p & top-k sampling
verification.mandatory_preflight: exact frozen test selection in one fresh process with zero skips after all pinned dependency patches
verification.require_log_pattern: FlashInfer top-p/top-k sampling disabled via VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0
